title: Reusable garage prop kit
summary: Garage sets now use painted low-poly barrels, wooden crates and abandoned cars.
notes: Add reusable floor-centred barrel, crate and sedan prefabs with fitted static collision.
Give each model a padded polygon UV unwrap and generated GoldSrc-style 128x128 textures.
Replace garage and storage placeholders, add barrels to pump sets and supply GLBs, templates and a checker workshop.
